posts.what: Seen from out at sea, the bright reflective water around the island turns dark and glossy, and the crab, a blue friend and the sheep walk off the beach onto it and drift slowly toward and past the camera; nothing else on the island changes.
posts.recipe: the whole sea changes material, friends step out onto it and drift
posts.shared: glassy weather-like change with friends drifting oddly

posts.what: A low view over the meadow by the cottage: a golden figure floats up shedding crumbs, the sand path and pigs blink in and out, and at the end a sheep and some things fly up; the stomp ring that should throw friends is still not clearly shown.
posts.recipe: retake of the stomp-wave ground rule, glitching again
posts.shared: same stomp rule, same meadow, same blinking sand failure; only a little more lift
